metadata.location_grid_provenance: location_grid computed by score_keywords.py --select-locations over a candidate pool filtered to the 12 analyst-approved Phase 2 suburbs. The unfiltered run selected a different 12: 10 zero-volume suburbs tied at opportunity_score 0.4530 and the tie was broken arbitrarily, which moved 5 of 7 swaps. Filtering the INPUT pool (rather than overriding the grid OUTPUT) keeps the grid fully deterministic while honouring the Phase 2 human checkpoint and the drive-time / ADG-proven evidence the scorer has no visibility into. Analyst decision 2026-07-27.
